purpose: Forward an address on the existing Cloudflare domain to the deployed Pages site. Do not change nameservers, and do not attach the domain as a custom domain until the nameservers are on Cloudflare.
zone: Replace with the domain already in your Cloudflare account, for example nexpertsacademy.com

dnsRecordToAdd.name: grants
dnsRecordToAdd.comment: Dummy proxied record so grants.yourdomain.com reaches Cloudflare. Redirect visitors before they touch this address. Leave the existing website records unchanged.
